new_hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b50fb3af8e0dad29a4'

"

api_key = open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '/claude_home/.galaxy/api_key')).read().strip()
gi = GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

# Copy datasets from seed to new history
seed_hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b59df98902ce5f37e2'
new_hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b50fb3af8e0dad29a4'

seed_contents = gi.histories.show_history(seed_hist_id, contents=True)
for ds in seed_contents:
    ds_id = ds['id']
    ds_name = ds['name']
    print(f'Copying {ds_name} ({ds_id})...')
    gi.histories.copy_dataset(new_hist_id, ds_id)
print('Done')
"
